best_lineage.idea: Replace the recursive merge sort with a 4-pass LSD radix sort (8 bits per pass) that accumulates all digit histograms in a single forward pass, skips passes where all keys share the same digit, and uses a single scratch buffer for ping-pong scattering, drastically reducing comparison overhead and improving cache utilization.
